verdict.rationale: Docusaurus exposes a documented CLI and Node.js config/plugin API (docs-8, docs-11/21, probe-4) that lets scripts or agents scaffold, build, and configure sites programmatically, confirmed by a real keyless CLI scaffold roundtrip (probe-rt-1). However there is no true public HTTP/REST API or machine-readable spec for AI agents: llms.txt, docs.md, and OpenAPI endpoints all return 404 (probe-1, probe-2, probe-3). Missing for 10: a genuine external API surface (REST/OpenAPI or llms.txt) beyond CLI/config, and any AI-specific integration documentation.
